name: Freshwater Eel (Unagi) Nigiri with Sweet Glaze
whyItWorks: Broiled freshwater eel is rich, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and very easy to chew and digest over white sushi rice. The sweet kabayaki reduction contains no fiber or irritating spices.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Confirm no sesame seeds are sprinkled on top. Enjoy with a dab of sweet unagi glaze.
